message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to real‑time clocks, so I can’t tell you the precise moment right now.  
The most reliable way to find today’s local time in New York City (or anywhere else) is:

1. **Check your phone/computer clock** – it usually shows the correct local time if your device’s timezone setting is set to “New York” / Eastern Time (ET).  
2. **Use an online world clock** – sites such as [worldtimezone.com](https://www.worldtimezone.com/), [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/) or simply Google “current time NY” will display the up‑to‑second time.  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant, etc., can read out the current time when prompted.  

If you need the time programmatically, many APIs return the current timestamp for a specified timezone (e.g., WorldTimeAPI, Google Maps Time Zone API).

Let me know if you'd like help formatting those results or integrating them into code!
